mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the lung and body routes was most worthwhile because it showed how the two heart sides form one continuous circuit.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the left valves repeated the right-side work, and the description saying the chamber gap remained pale after fitting its valve was confusing.

surprise.text: The heart muscle needs its own blood vessels; blood inside the chambers cannot supply all of its thick wall.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although several later steps offered only one combination, making them more like following instructions than choosing.

continue.text: I might continue if the next chapter connects the circulation to another body system; seeing the complete route was useful, though the repeated fittings were less engaging.
